_comment: Names this engine emits as preferred that the pinned reference parser cannot read.
A gap waives ONE expectation: that the reference parser accepts the string. The exact
expected name and the independent structural reconstruction stay mandatory, the parser is
still invoked, and the rejection is still counted as a rejection in the interoperability
metric - it is never reported as a round trip.
A gap applies only to the recorded parser artifact. If that parser later accepts the name
the gap is stale and must be retired; if it returns a different structure the case fails,
because an expected rejection never licenses a mismatch.

rationale: Two nonoverlapping isoquinoline parents fused to one 1,4-oxathiine interparent
component is a multiparent system, so the parent is multiplied and the second
parent's fusion letters are primed. The baseline it replaced has pyridine as its
parent with isoquinolino as a higher-order attached component, which is less senior.
Independent reconstruction: 22 skeletal atoms, 26 edges, D0 = 10, u = 0, four hydro
increments at 3, 4, 10 and 11, reconstructing the target without copying its
parser_note: parses with one heteroatom swapped. Only this combination is refused. That locates
the behaviour reproducibly; it does not identify the cause inside the parser.
gaps.review_trigger: any change to the parser artifact above
gaps.retire_when: the recorded parser returns the target structure for the expected name
